summary: Retested the fix for a malformed MONGO_URL. Everything requested passed. Simulated Vercel runtime: /tmp/t314 venv, Python 3.14.9, env -i VERCEL=1, frontend/api/index.py (identical to backend/server.py). Eight malformed MONGO_URL values were tried: 'mongodb//localhost', 'http://localhost:27017', a value wrapped in quotes, a password with an unescaped '@', leading/trailing spaces, an empty string, 'mongodb+srv://user:pw@' and mongodb+srv with a port. For every one: import does not raise (about 0.4s), /api/health returns 503 with missing_settings containing 'MONGO_URL (invalid format)' and database 'unreachable' (no ping attempted), POST /api/contact returns JSON 503 'Server is not fully configured yet...', and login returns 503 (32/32 checks passed). With valid local Mongo (DB beskarit_vtest) and all required env: health 200 healthy; contact POST 200 {success:true, id, email_sent:false} because reCAPTCHA and Brevo are unset there; the row persisted; an invalid payload gives 422 JSON; beskarit_vtest dropped (5/5 passed). Frontend, with Playwright route mocks on /api/contact: a JSON 503 shows the server detail, a JSON 400 shows the server detail, and a non-JSON 500 shows the 'Unable to send message' fallback as expected (3/3 passed). Preview regression: /api/health 200 healthy; the reCAPTCHA regression pytest passed 4/4; a real UI contact submit returns 400 'We couldn't verify you're human', which is expected and acceptable because the reCAPTCHA badge shows 'Invalid domain' for the preview host; admin login (API 200 with HttpOnly Secure cookie, bcrypt $2b$) and admin UI dashboard work.

minor.issue: An empty MONGO_URL ('') is listed twice: missing_settings = ['MONGO_URL', 'MONGO_URL (invalid format)']. This is cosmetic.

The value is not stripped or unquoted before MongoClient(). A URL that is valid but has surrounding spaces or quotes (common when pasting into Vercel) is rejected as invalid instead of being auto-healed. Consider os.environ.get('MONGO_URL','').strip().strip('"\''). This is optional, since health now clearly reports the problem.

Carried over from iteration 13: 503 responses bypass CORS and security headers, because this is the outermost middleware. A slow 500 is still possible when the DB is reachable at import but unreachable at request time.

issues: The portal-preview-popup and consent banner overlay the contact form on first load. This is expected UX, but tests must dismiss them ('Continue to Website', 'Reject All') before clicking Send Message.

action_items: No blocking issues. To fix the live site, the user must redeploy on Vercel and then open https://www.beskarit.com/api/health. The missing_settings field will name anything wrong; if it shows 'MONGO_URL (invalid format)', remove quotes and spaces and URL-encode special characters in the Atlas password.
Optional: strip whitespace and quotes from MONGO_URL, and de-duplicate the empty-MONGO_URL entry in missing_settings.
critical_code_review_comments: The InvalidURI/ConfigurationError guard works. The fallback MongoClient(connect=False) is never pinged, because health skips the ping when MONGO_URL is in MISSING_ENV and the middleware blocks other routes.
frontend/api/index.py is still a manual copy of server.py (currently identical), so the two can drift.
The ContactSection error handling is correct: JSON detail strings are shown, a 422 array detail shows the generic 'check the form' message, and non-JSON responses fall back to the email message.

success_rate.backend: 100% (32/32 malformed-URI checks, 5/5 valid env, 4/4 preview regression)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (3/3 mocked error displays, real submit gives the expected 400 message, admin login OK)
